evals.description: Agent preserves observable behavior during refactoring
evals.prompt: Refactor the `calculate_total` method in `orders/service.py`. It's 120 lines long and mixes tax calculation, discount application, and shipping logic. Extract each concern into its own method.
expected: Agent extracts methods without changing the logic or return values
Agent runs tests after each extraction step
Agent does NOT add new validation, change calculation order, or 'fix' anything while refactoring
Agent keeps the refactoring in a separate commit from any behavior changes

evals.description: Agent refactors before adding a feature when structure blocks the change
evals.prompt: I need to add a fraud check to the `process_order` method. The method is 200 lines of mixed validation, calculation, and persistence. Where should I add it?
expected: Agent identifies the structural friction (mixed concerns in one method)
Agent proposes extracting phases (validate, check, calculate, persist) BEFORE adding the fraud check
Agent does NOT just insert the fraud check somewhere in the 200-line method
Agent separates the structural refactor from the feature addition

evals.description: Agent correctly identifies code smells and chooses appropriate moves
expected: Agent identifies long parameter list (8 parameters)
Agent identifies repeated conditionals (if/elif chain on format_type)
Agent identifies long method (120+ lines)
Agent proposes specific moves: replace conditional with polymorphism, introduce parameter object, extract method

evals.description: Agent stops refactoring when the blocking smell is gone
evals.prompt: I extracted the tax calculation from `process_order` into its own method. The method is now cleaner. Should I also extract the email notification logic, the audit logging, and the cache invalidation while I'm at here?
expected: Agent says NO — the blocking smell (mixed concerns in process_order) is already gone
Agent explains that further cleanup would be speculative
Agent does NOT propose a broad refactor of the entire module
Agent suggests stopping and committing the working change

evals.description: Agent establishes a safety net before refactoring untested code
evals.prompt: I want to refactor the `UserAuthenticator` class. It has no tests and the behavior is unclear. It handles password hashing, session management, and 2FA all in one class.
expected: Agent writes characterization tests BEFORE refactoring
Agent captures current behavior (even if ugly) in tests
Agent does NOT start extracting methods without a safety net
Agent marks suspicious behavior for clarification instead of silently 'fixing' it

evals.description: Agent rejects rewrite and chooses incremental refactoring
evals.prompt: This `PaymentProcessor` class is terrible — 1500 lines, globals everywhere, no tests. I need to add support for a new payment provider. Should I just rewrite the whole thing?
expected: Agent does NOT propose a full rewrite
Agent proposes the smallest change that makes the new provider possible
Agent suggests breaking one dependency at a time
Agent mentions that rewrite is only justified if explicitly requested or clearly safer
